FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Deli Delight Sandwich Shop specializes in the assembly and serving of high-quality sandwiches and deli products sourced from licensed, reputable vendors. Our operations focus exclusively on using household-type appliances, such as microwave ovens and toasters, for minimal food preparation, ensuring a safe and compliant environment. We adhere to all local health department regulations and food safety standards, prioritizing our customers' health and satisfaction. We maintain a low-risk operational model, which contributes to our overall safety and liability management. Our experienced staff receives comprehensive food safety training to further minimize risks associated with foodborne illnesses. Deli Delight operates in a welcoming retail space during standard business hours, serving our community while remaining committed to stringent health and safety practices.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred due to a minor water damage incident on 06/15/2022, caused by a plumbing leak in the restroom, amounting to $1,000. Status: Resolved. Additionally, a small theft incident recorded on 09/10/2022, where a customer inventory worth $500 went missing. Status: In process of investigation.

FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: "Central station alarm system and regularly monitored surveillance cameras to enhance security and deter theft."
